Timed SQL mock interview online: rehearse the screen before the screen

SQL Quest's mock interviews run in your browser against a clock: a time limit for the whole sitting and one for each question, your query checked against the expected rows, and a score against a pass mark at the end. The SQL Fundamentals Assessment (4 questions, 25 minutes) is free with no signup. The other 10 mocks are Pro, from 30 to 90 minutes.

What the clock changes

Practice lets you stop, look something up and come back tomorrow. A timed sitting does not: the clock runs while you read the tables, while you think and while you fix a typo.

In a SQL Quest mock each question has its own time limit, and when it runs out your answer is submitted as it stands. When the whole clock runs out, the mock ends and is scored.

A written answer is run and its rows are compared with the expected rows, so a query that runs but returns the wrong rows scores as wrong. At the end you get a score against the mock's pass mark.

How to rehearse a timed SQL screen

  1. Find your weakest skill. The readiness test shows a Skillmap across the nine skills and the one to fix first, with no signup. Take the readiness test.
  2. Practise it untimed first. Solve that skill's Medium questions until you can write them without a hint. The 2-week prep plan lays the nine skills out one a day. Open the 2-week plan.
  3. Sit the free mock as if it were the screen. One sitting, no other tabs, no hints. Read every table before you write a line. Start the SQL Fundamentals Assessment.
  4. Read each miss, then retry only the misses. Every wrong answer gets one sentence saying what went wrong. A retry gives you only the questions you missed, on a clock scaled to how many they are.
  5. Sit a Pro mock that matches the interview. A few days before, take the mock that matches your role or the company, so the format is not new on the day.

Questions

Is there a free SQL mock interview?

Yes: the SQL Fundamentals Assessment, 4 written SQL questions in 25 minutes with a pass mark of 60%. It starts in the browser with no signup. The other 10 mocks are Pro.

How long is a mock interview?

From 25 minutes (SQL Fundamentals Assessment) to 90 minutes (Ten Classic SQL Interview Patterns). Each mock's length and question count are in the table on this page.

What happens when the time runs out?

Each question has its own limit; when it runs out, your answer is submitted as it stands. When the whole clock runs out, the mock ends and is scored against its pass mark.

Can I retry a mock?

Yes. After a mock you can retry only the questions you missed, on a clock scaled to how many they are, and every wrong answer carries one sentence on what went wrong.

Are the Capital One and Revolut mocks the real interview?

No. They are practice modelled on what candidates report about those screens, and each company page lists its sources with dates. No company wrote or endorsed them.

Which SQL dialect do the mocks use?

SQLite, in your browser. Joins, GROUP BY, CTEs and window functions are written the same way in PostgreSQL, MySQL and Snowflake; dates are where they differ.
